Actually, I just clicked on the yellow block (row 20, col 24) and then pressed RIGHT, and the light green block moved. So clicking on the yellow block didn't change the focus.
But wait - the initial state had the light green block in a specific position. Maybe the arrow keys always move the bottom-most colored block, or maybe there's a different selection mechanism I haven't discovered.
Let me try clicking directly on the light green block and then using arrow keys to confirm it's the same block that moves.

    print(f"  ({r},{c}): {old} -> {new}")
